narrative.overview: Owner-selected direction C, Bright works: static-first and country-neutral, with charcoal/lime, bold type, contrasting planned-tool panels and the original woven M/W identity.
northStarRules: Make planned tools honest and easy to understand.
Preserve direction C's original mark, charcoal/lime palette, sharp corners and bold two-line headline.
do: Keep English-default and Swedish content aligned.
Preserve native links, disclosures and accessible focus.
Keep the database status subordinate to site content.
dont: Do not fabricate financial data or ready-to-use calculators.
Do not assume a currency, tax jurisdiction or trading method.
Do not turn the illustrative expansion study into approved features.
